{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools TaggedCache handoff (milestones 1-3 complete)

## Status: R01-R08 implemented in src/cachetools/tagged.py
- R01 put/get deep copies, tag validation (bare string & nonstring rejected
  before mutation, dedup, finite iterable, generators consumed once).
- R02 invalidate(tag); replace drops old tags; eviction prunes memberships;
  get refreshes LRU; put-overwrite refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A).
- R03 maxsize positive int, bool excluded; one slot per value.
- R04 invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'); empty tags -> 0; invalid
  mode/tags raise ValueError before mutation.
- R05 resize(maxsize): validate first; shrink evicts LRU; grow no eviction;
  survivors keep values/tags/LRU order AND absolute expiry (round-2 note).
- R06 generator tags consumed once; detached nested values.
- R07 ctor timer=None (time.monotonic); put ttl=None; finite nonneg int/float
  (bool excluded, inf/nan rejected) -> expiry = timer()+ttl; ttl=0 immediate;
  exact boundary now >= expiry is expired; invalid ttl raises before mutation.
- R08 purge expired before get/put/len/resize/invalidate/invalidate_many/pop
  (pop added purge too); purge never touches survivor recency; overwrite
  replaces expiry; invalidation counts live only; expired get -> KeyError;
  no timer/ttl callers unchanged (timer only called when expiry entries exist).

## Key implementation notes
- _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) subclass records evicted keys in _evicted list;
  _resize mutates _Cache__maxsize and pops LRU via popitem().
- TaggedCache keeps __expiry dict key->absolute expiry or None; __purge_expired
  iterates a snapshot list(expiry) and skips None; a failing timer is caught
  (no entries expire). __contains__ does NOT purge (not in R08 list).
- put: validate tags+ttl -> purge -> expiry computed once -> replace path
  swaps tags/expiry, insert path evicts LRU if full.
- resize: validate -> purge -> _resize -> forget evicted -> set __maxsize.

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py (mine, 101 tests) + acceptance_public.py (4) +
  upstream tests/ (313) all pass: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py
- Scratch TTL edge tests were in /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py (20 tests, all pass);
  /tmp may not persist - re-derive from R07/R08 text if needed.

## Gotchas
- Upstream cachetools tests must stay unchanged; only tagged.py/test_tagged.py
  are new files. Run with PYTHONPATH=src:.
- 'finite' ttl: use math.isfinite (rejects inf AND nan).
- Superseded design note (empty all-tags matches everything / resize flushes)
  is WRONG per R04/R05 - do not reintroduce.
EOF
echo updated; wc -l HANDOFF.md"}
